Six-week groupstwo sessions a week, in a small group.

Four weeks is too short to feel the difference, so we've made it six. You'll come twice a week with the same small group, one session downstairs in the gym and one upstairs in the studio. When one cycle ends the next begins, so you can join at the start of any cycle.

The six-week groups

Six weeks, two sessions a week, in a small group of people starting at the same point as you. One session downstairs in the gym and one upstairs in the studio. The groups run in six-week cycles all year: the next runs from the week of 16 November up to Christmas, and the one after that starts in January 2027 date.

What you get

  • Two sessions a week for six weeks, for £50 in total
  • The same small group each week, all starting together
  • A strength session in the gym and a yoga class in the studio
  • Unheated sessions, plus a warm stretch for The Unstiffening
  • 15% off your first membership or class pack when the six weeks end

The six weeks are sign-up only, not drop-in, so everyone in the group starts and finishes together. Spaces are limited.

Message Helen to join
Do I need to be fit already?

No. The six weeks are for people starting from wherever they are, and every exercise has an easier and a harder version.

What if I miss a session?

Life happens. Let Helen know and she'll help you catch up. catch-up policy

Can I just try one class first?

Yes. If the six weeks aren't for you, bring our leaflet and your first class is free.

What happens after six weeks?

The groups run in cycles, so you can carry straight on into the next six weeks with your group. Or you can move into any of our regular classes, with 15% off your first membership or class pack. Two weeks before the end, Helen will chat to you about what suits you best.

When does the next cycle start?

The next cycle starts the week of 16 November and runs up to Christmas. The one after that starts in January 2027 date. If you can't make this one, save your place for the next.
